component.name: Pear Notes
component.summary: Private notes, encrypted on-device and synced peer-to-peer

description.p: Pear Notes keeps your notes on your own devices. Notes are encrypted on-device and sync directly between your linked devices, with no account and no server.

ul.li: Link your phone, tablet and computers and keep them in sync peer-to-peer
Attach images, PDFs and voice notes
Encrypted backups you can restore on any device
